exclusions: label-like >10 as a primary fresh class
selection_rule.name: T4_BOUNDED_FRESH_YIELD_PLUS_STRICT_SECOND_PASS
selection_rule.reconstructible_from: T3 candidate audit + T1/T2/T3 semantic-review dispositions
steps: Partition current strict-longest residuals into mutually exclusive history classes A-H.
Treat all T1/T2/T3 SKIP IDs, including the seven T3 reopened-then-skipped IDs, as CLOSED.
Do not requeue q109 or any T3 SKIP merely because a remaining gap is numerically small.
Do not requeue T3 non-crossing EDITs as a class; third-or-later edits are presumptively SKIP.

SECOND_PASS_ELIGIBLE: one prior EDIT, not a SKIP, unused semantic contrast (T1 CORRECT_ONLY with untouched distractors that are not high-risk labels, or T2 DISTRACTOR_ONLY near-crossing with leftover product-job contrast), HIGH_CONFIDENCE or POSSIBLE only, cap 10.
FRESH_ELIGIBLE: NEVER_REVIEWED, Learn authority present, TIER_A or TIER_B. Includes 21-50 first; 11-20 next; 0-10 last among <=50; sentence-like >50 only if already TIER_B.
Rank fresh by gap band (21-30, 31-40, 41-50, 11-20, 0-10, >50), then structure (sentence-like, short-phrase, label-like), then relative_gap desc, absolute_gap desc, question_id.

Fill INTERMEDIATE_64 domain quotas (security 24, compliance 15, entra 17, SCI 8) from second-pass cap then fresh rank. Compliance 15 is population-capped by eligible TIER_A/B fresh+second-pass. Spill only if a quota cannot be filled.
